reportPage.content.welcomeDescription: AppNode is an AI-powered development platform that lets you build complete web applications just by describing what you want. No coding experience required — it feels like having a whole team working for you.
reportPage.content.howItWorksDescription: Simply describe your project in plain language. Our AI understands your requirements, generates a complete blueprint, and builds production-ready code in real-time. Watch your app come to life with instant previews.
reportPage.content.steps.describeText: Tell AI what you want to build
reportPage.content.quickstartDescription: Get up and running with AppNode in minutes. Choose your path based on how you want to start building.
reportPage.content.createWithAiDescripti: The fastest way to build. Just describe what you want in plain language and watch AI create your complete application in real-time.
reportPage.content.startNewProjectDesc: Click "Create New" from your dashboard or the homepage
reportPage.content.describeYourIdeaDesc: Write a detailed description of what you want to build. The more context, the better results.
reportPage.content.reviewBlueprintDesc: AI generates a project blueprint with features, design, and architecture. You can refine it.
reportPage.content.watchItBuildDesc: AI writes code for each component. See files appear in real-time with live preview.
reportPage.content.testIterateDesc: Try your app in the preview. Ask AI to make changes or add features.
reportPage.content.deployStepDesc: When ready, deploy with one click to get a live URL.
reportPage.content.tipSpecificDesc: Instead of "make a website", say "create a portfolio website with a dark theme, project gallery, and contact form"
reportPage.content.tipFeaturesDesc: List the key features you need — authentication, database, file uploads, etc.
reportPage.content.tipDesignDesc: Colors, style (minimal, bold, playful), and layout preferences help AI match your vision
reportPage.content.tipIterateDesc: Start simple, then ask AI to add more features incrementally
reportPage.content.buildFromScratchDesc: Start with a blank canvas and full control. Perfect for developers who want to structure their project their way while still leveraging AI assistance.
reportPage.content.chooseTemplateDesc: Select a base template to start with. Each template comes pre-configured with the framework, build tools, and dependencies you need.
reportPage.content.codeEditorDesc: Full-featured editor with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, and multi-file editing
reportPage.content.fileExplorerDesc: Navigate and manage your project files and folders
reportPage.content.terminalDesc: Run commands, install packages, and manage your environment
reportPage.content.livePreviewDesc: See changes instantly as you code
reportPage.content.aiChatDesc: Ask for help, generate code snippets, or debug issues
reportPage.content.versionControlDesc: Built-in git integration to track changes
reportPage.content.importGithubDesc: Bring your existing projects to AppNode. Import any public or private repository and enhance it with AI-powered development tools.
reportPage.content.connectGithubDesc: Authorize AppNode to access your GitHub account for seamless imports
reportPage.content.selectRepositoryDesc: Choose from your repositories or paste any public repo URL
reportPage.content.configureSettingsDesc: Select branch, set environment variables, and configure build settings
reportPage.content.importBuildDesc: We clone your repo, install dependencies, and start the dev server
reportPage.content.afterImport1: Your code is cloned into a new AppNode workspace
reportPage.content.afterImport3: Development server starts with live preview
reportPage.content.afterImport4: AI analyzes your codebase to provide contextual help
reportPage.content.afterImport5: Changes can be pushed back to GitHub or exported
reportPage.content.privateRepoNoteDesc: For private repositories, you'll need to authorize GitHub access. We only request the minimum permissions needed to clone your code.
reportPage.content.bestForBeginners: Best for beginners — describe your idea and let AI build it
reportPage.content.blankCanvas: Start with a blank canvas and full control
reportPage.content.bringExisting: Bring your existing project and enhance it with AI
reportPage.content.useTemplateDesc: Start from a pre-built template and customize it
reportPage.content.examplePrompt1: "Create a todo list with drag and drop and dark mode"
reportPage.content.examplePrompt2: "Build a simple drawing app with different brush sizes and colors"
reportPage.content.examplePrompt3: "Make a memory card game with emojis"
reportPage.content.examplePrompt4: "Create an expense tracker with charts and categories"
reportPage.content.trustOverviewDesc: We're committed to maintaining a safe, trustworthy platform for all users. Our Trust & Safety team works around the clock to ensure AppNode remains a space where creators can build without fear.
reportPage.content.howWeKeepYouSafeDesc: Our multi-layered approach to safety includes automated detection systems, human review processes, and community reporting tools. We continuously improve our systems based on emerging threats and user feedback.
reportPage.content.reportingAbuseDesc: If you encounter content or behavior that violates our policies, please report it immediately. We take all reports seriously and investigate promptly.
reportPage.content.howToReport1: Click the "Report" button on any project or user profile
reportPage.content.howToReport3: Use the contact form in your account settings
reportPage.content.copyrightClaimsDesc: We respect intellectual property rights and respond promptly to valid copyright claims.
reportPage.content.filingClaimDesc: To file a DMCA takedown notice, please email contact@appnode.ai with:
reportPage.content.claimItem4: A statement of good faith belief
reportPage.content.termsIntro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of AppNode's services, websites, and applications ("Services"). By using our Services, you agree to be bound by these Terms.
reportPage.content.acceptanceOfTermsDesc: By accessing or using our Services, you agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree to these Terms, you may not access or use our Services.
reportPage.content.descriptionOfServices: AppNode provides an AI-powered development platform that enables users to build websites, applications, and digital products. Our Services include code generation, hosting, collaboration tools, and related features.
reportPage.content.userAccountsDesc: To use certain features, you must create an account. You agree to:
reportPage.content.userAccount2: Maintain the security of your account credentials
reportPage.content.userAccount3: Accept responsibility for all activities under your account
reportPage.content.userAccount4: Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use
reportPage.content.acceptableUseDesc: You agree not to use our Services to:
reportPage.content.acceptableUse1: Violate any applicable laws or regulations
reportPage.content.acceptableUse3: Distribute malware, spam, or harmful content
reportPage.content.acceptableUse5: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
reportPage.content.acceptableUse6: Use our Services for any illegal or unauthorized purpose
reportPage.content.intellectualPropertyD: You retain ownership of content you create using our Services. By using our Services, you grant us a limited license to host, display, and distribute your content as necessary to provide the Services.
reportPage.content.terminationDesc: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account for violations of these Terms or for any other reason at our discretion. You may also terminate your account at any time.
reportPage.content.disclaimersDesc: OUR SERVICES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED. WE DO NOT GUARANTEE THAT OUR SERVICES WILL BE UNINTERRUPTED, SECURE, OR ERROR-FREE.
reportPage.content.termsContactDesc: For questions about these Terms, contact us at contact@appnode.ai
reportPage.content.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy describes how AppNode collects, uses, and shares information about you when you use our services.
reportPage.content.useInfo2: Process transactions and send related information
reportPage.content.useInfo3: Send technical notices and support messages
reportPage.content.useInfo4: Respond to your comments and questions
reportPage.content.privacyContactDesc: For privacy-related questions, contact us at contact@appnode.ai
reportPage.content.platformRulesDesc: These rules help maintain a safe and productive environment for all AppNode users.
reportPage.content.prohibited3: Content that promotes violence or hate
reportPage.content.securityOverviewDesc: Security is foundational to everything we build. We implement industry-leading practices to protect your data, your projects, and your users.
reportPage.content.appSecurity1: Regular penetration testing by third-party firms
reportPage.content.appSecurity2: Automated vulnerability scanning in CI/CD pipeline
reportPage.content.appSecurity4: Code review requirements for all changes
reportPage.content.appSecurity5: Bug bounty program for responsible disclosure
reportPage.content.accountSec4: Secure password requirements with bcrypt hashing
reportPage.content.complianceDesc: We maintain compliance with industry standards and regulations:
reportPage.content.reportVulnerabilityDe: Found a security issue? Please report it responsibly to contact@appnode.ai. We appreciate your help in keeping AppNode secure and offer rewards for valid reports.
reportPage.content.dataProtectionDesc: We take data protection seriously. Your code, your projects, and your personal information are safeguarded with multiple layers of protection.
reportPage.content.dataRight2: Export your projects at any time
reportPage.content.dataRetentionDesc: We retain your data only as long as necessary to provide our services. When you delete your account, your data is permanently removed within 30 days.
reportPage.content.generateCodeDesc: Learn different ways to generate code using AppNode's AI capabilities.
reportPage.content.usingPromptBarDesc: The prompt bar is your primary interface for AI code generation. Type natural language descriptions to create components, pages, or entire features.
reportPage.content.contextualGenerationD: Right-click any file or folder to generate code in context. AI understands your project structure and generates compatible code.
reportPage.content.codeCompletionDesc: As you type, AI suggests completions based on your code context. Accept suggestions with Tab or continue typing to refine.
reportPage.content.firstAppIntro: Follow this step-by-step guide to build your first application with AppNode.
reportPage.content.firstAppStep1Text: Click "Create New" from your dashboard and choose "Create with AI" for the easiest start.
reportPage.content.firstAppStep2Text: Try this prompt: "Create a simple todo list app with the ability to add, complete, and delete tasks. Use a clean, minimal design with a light theme."
reportPage.content.firstAppStep3Text: AI will generate your app in real-time. You'll see files being created and a live preview updating as code is written.
reportPage.content.firstAppStep4Text: Try asking: "Add a dark mode toggle" or "Make the completed tasks strikethrough" to see how AI can iterate on your app.
reportPage.content.databasesIntro: Learn how to add persistent data storage to your AppNode applications.
reportPage.content.databasesSqliteDesc: Simple, file-based database. Great for small apps.
reportPage.content.databasesPostgresDesc: Full-featured relational database for complex data.
reportPage.content.databasesRedisDesc: In-memory store for caching and sessions.
reportPage.content.databasesAddingText: Simply describe your data needs: "I need to store users with name, email, and profile picture" and AI will set up the database schema and connections for you.
reportPage.content.deployingIntro: Get your application live with one click. AppNode handles hosting, SSL, and scaling automatically.
reportPage.content.deployingStep1Text: Hit the Deploy button in your workspace
reportPage.content.deployingStep2Text: Use our free subdomain or connect your own
reportPage.content.deployingStep3Text: Your app is deployed in seconds with SSL included
reportPage.content.deployingCustomText: Connect your own domain by adding a CNAME record pointing to AppNode. SSL certificates are automatically provisioned.
reportPage.content.teamsIntro: Collaborate with your team on AppNode. Share projects, manage permissions, and build together in real-time.
reportPage.content.teamsSharedDesc: All team members can access and contribute to projects
reportPage.content.teamsRoleDesc: Control who can view, edit, or deploy

reportPage.content.enterpriseAuditDesc: Track all actions across your organization
reportPage.content.enterpriseSupportDesc: Priority support with dedicated account manager
reportPage.content.enterpriseCloudDesc: Run AppNode in your own infrastructure
reportPage.content.collaborationIntro: Work together seamlessly with real-time collaboration features.
reportPage.content.collaborationItem1: See teammates' cursors in the editor
reportPage.content.collaborationCommText: Use the built-in chat or connect your Slack workspace for seamless team communication.
reportPage.content.changelogText: We're working on something exciting. Check back soon for updates on the latest features and improvements.
reportPage.content.roadmapIntro: See what we're working on and what's coming next.

securityReportPage.guidelines.items: Do not access, modify, or delete data belonging to other users.

Only test against accounts you own or have permission to access.

learnPublishPage.title: Build & Publish with AppNode
learnPublishPage.steps.title: Four Simple Steps
learnPublishPage.steps.subtitle: Creating and publishing your app has never been easier. Follow these steps to go from idea to live application.

learnPublishPage.steps.items.title: Describe Your App
learnPublishPage.steps.items.description: Start by telling AppNode what you want to build. Use natural language to describe your app's features, design, and functionality. The more specific you are, the better the result.

learnPublishPage.steps.items.title: Watch It Build
learnPublishPage.steps.items.description: AppNode's AI generates your application in real-time. You'll see the code being written and your app taking shape with instant previews. Make changes by simply asking for them.

learnPublishPage.steps.items.title: Preview & Iterate
learnPublishPage.steps.items.description: Test your app directly in the browser. See how it looks on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Request changes, add features, or adjust styling until it's perfect.

learnPublishPage.steps.items.title: Deploy Instantly
learnPublishPage.steps.items.description: When you're ready, publish your app with one click. Get a custom domain, SSL certificate, and global CDN automatically. Your app is live in seconds.

learnPublishPage.features.title: Deployment Features
learnPublishPage.features.subtitle: Everything you need to publish professional applications is included out of the box.

learnPublishPage.features.items.title: One-Click Deployment
learnPublishPage.features.items.description: No complex setup or configuration. Just click deploy and your app is live.

learnPublishPage.features.items.title: Custom Domains
learnPublishPage.features.items.description: Connect your own domain or use our free subdomain for instant publishing.

learnPublishPage.features.items.title: SSL Certificates
learnPublishPage.features.items.description: Automatic HTTPS for all your apps. Security comes standard.

learnPublishPage.features.items.title: Global CDN
learnPublishPage.features.items.description: Your app is served from edge locations worldwide for blazing fast speeds.

learnPublishPage.features.items.title: Instant Rollbacks
learnPublishPage.features.items.description: Made a mistake? Roll back to any previous version with one click.

learnPublishPage.features.items.title: Built-in Analytics
learnPublishPage.features.items.description: Track visitors, page views, and performance metrics out of the box.

learnPublishPage.tips.title: Tips for Best Results

learnPublishPage.tips.items.text: Describe colors, layouts, and functionality you want
Begin with core features, then add more over time
Share examples of apps or websites you like
Check desktop, tablet, and mobile views
